prompts.prompt:
Generate Lovart SEO quarterly report.

1. Identify the 3 completed months in the ending quarter.
2. For each month M: if report missing, run:
   python3 "1-4 Dev/scripts/seo_monthly_v2.py" --month M
3. Synthesize one quarterly MD under 1-2 Insight/Trident Insights/reports/quarterly/ with traffic trends, winners/losers, OKR, actions (max 5)
4. bash report-notify --type seo-quarterly --status ok --summary "<3 bullets>" --artifact "<quarterly md path>"
5. Notion data_source_id 61514ed3-39e2-4d84-b860-8334d740823e

No Sanity import.
